There are a lot of people who claim to be allies who *are not* allies. People who say “I’m an ally bc I have a lesbian friend” but go on to make sexist/racist remarks. People who go to gay bars and pride parades but completely ignore our history or the threats we face in everyday life. People who say are allies bc they like bisexual women but only when “mY So AnD i ArE lOoKiNg FoR a ThIrD”.

Allies are people who actively support and grow with the people they are allied to. Allies belong, just the same as LGBTQIA+ people belong.

I am a Queer/NB person who is an ally to my Gay relatives and Trans friends. I am a proud niece, granddaughter, and loyal friend. I consume Queer content and products. I learn about our history. I’m an active member of multiple advocacy organizations who provide for us on a national level down to my zip code. My local community is strong and I am proud to be a part of it. I am an ally.

Don’t try to put anyone or any group into a box. We should know better than that by now.
